long_biography.plain_text:
Born in April 1971, Korotchenko developed a Saint Petersburg industrial network through Sudotechnology. He held an equity interest and advised the chief executive as the company supplied machinery and components to Russian Railways. He also served on the boards of Kalugatransmash, First Non-Metallic Company and Trust Number 7.

By 2014 Korotchenko owned 49.5 percent of Bamstroymekhanizatsiya's management company. The railway contractor subsequently won three major projects to expand the BAM and Trans-Siberian corridors, and he later sold the stake. His disclosed interests have included industrial automation, electrical and railway equipment, road construction, real estate and healthcare. That portfolio is built around infrastructure and industrial assets rather than one operating company.
